name: Worcestershire Sauce
siboNotes: Generally well tolerated in typical serving sizes, but some brands may contain garlic powder - check ingredients if highly sensitive.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels as some brands may contain onion or garlic powder
Use sparingly as it's quite flavorful and sodium-rich
Store in refrigerator after opening for best quality
Shake well before use as ingredients may separate
alternatives: Tamari or soy sauce with a splash of vinegar
Fish sauce mixed with rice vinegar
Homemade blend of anchovies, vinegar, and spices
Low-sodium soy sauce with lemon juice
pairsWellWith: Roasted vegetables like carrots and potatoes
nutritionalHighlights: Very low in calories per serving
Contains small amounts of B vitamins from yeast extract
Provides umami flavor without added FODMAPs
Contains vinegar which may support digestion
